purpose: Single authoritative status registry connecting the property validation manifest, validation runner and validation dashboard.
registry_rules: Dashboard status is derived from this registry and the validation manifest; it is not independently editable.
A pathway cannot be marked PASSED without a recorded validation run.
A pathway cannot be marked publication-ready if a blocking failure, unresolved critical traceability issue or required legal verification gap remains.
Legal-source verification status and technical validation status remain separate.
A legal change can move a previously passed pathway to REVALIDATION_REQUIRED.
Historical snapshots and previous validation states must remain auditable.

derived_rules.BLOCKED: Any critical safety, privacy or traceability failure blocks publication.
derived_rules.REVALIDATION_REQUIRED: A material legal/evidence/procedure dependency changed after validation.
derived_rules.PASSED: Required technical validation layers passed and no blocking issue remains.
derived_rules.PASSED_WITH_NONCRITICAL_WARNINGS: Required gates passed but documented noncritical warnings remain.
derived_rules.READY: Passed validation, required legal verification acceptable, no blocking issue, current change status reviewed.
derived_rules.READY_WITH_WARNINGS: Publication gates pass with explicitly displayed noncritical warnings.
derived_rules.NOT_READY: One or more required publication gates remain incomplete.
